title: Watersound "Yachtpond Lane" 210 Yacht Pond Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private heated pool **Pool heating is available for this property from Oct 1st through May 1st for $35 per day **- 4-Passenger golf cart- 6 adult bikes- Peloton- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Discover the serenity of a seaside vacation at Yachtpond Lane, a 2-story home set in the heart of illustrious WaterSound. Sleeping up to 14 guests, there’s plenty of room for friends and family inside, with 6 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, and multiple living areas. Days of sun-drenched fun exploring the sugar-white beaches and copious natural beauty, followed by lively evenings of dining and entertainment at The Big Chill await. Guests will love sipping their morning coffee on the lookout as the sun rises over the community, grilling on the built-in barbecue, and sunning by the picturesque private pool.Upon arrival at this sunny 3,902 square-foot escape, a classic coastal exterior charms guests. In the combined living and dining area, hand-scraped hardwood floors span beneath 12-foot ceilings, accented with reclaimed beams. Gather the group on the plush sectional and armchairs for a movie night on the 75” Smart TV and Sonos soundbar. The gleaming kitchen’s Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances and spacious central island provide a pristine playground for culinary enthusiasts. Dine at the table for 8, with 4 more seats at the island. Fold back the NanaWall to merge the living room with the screened porch, where guests can grill, recline, and dine while enjoying the view of the nearby tidal pond. Cushioned loungers surround the private pool in the courtyard. As the day winds down, the primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and soaring cathedral ceiling offers a lavish spot to rest.Guests will find a secondary living space with a Smart TV and Peloton bike upstairs. Behind a sliding barn door is a comfortable bunk room perfect for teens or children with 2 twin-over-double beds. The rest of the floor comprises 4 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms and a spiral staircase that leads to the lookout with sweeping views of the community.Explore all that WaterSound can offer at Yachtpound Lane. There is parking for 2 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes—cruise the Timpoochee Trail and visit the rest of Scenic 30A! Guests have access to all WaterSound boardwalks for beach access. Book this captivating coastal home today.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Double Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateGolf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW.*Unfortunately, due to HOA rules, the guest will not be able to rent golf carts and will not be able to bring their own golf cart.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

DETAILS: Discover the serenity of a seaside vacation at Yachtpond Lane, a 2-story home set in the heart of illustrious WaterSound. Sleeping up to 14 guests, there’s plenty of room for friends and family inside, with 6 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, and multiple living areas. Days of sun-drenched fun exploring the sugar-white beaches and copious natural beauty, followed by lively evenings of dining and entertainment at The Big Chill await. Upon arrival at this sunny 3,902 square-foot escape, a classic coastal exterior charms guests. Cushioned loungers surround the private pool in the courtyard. As the day winds down, the primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and soaring cathedral ceiling offers a lavish spot to rest. Guests will find a secondary living space with a Smart TV and Peloton bike upstairs. Behind a sliding barn door is a comfortable bunk room perfect for teens or children with 2 twin-over-double beds. The rest of the floor comprises 4 guest bedrooms with king beds and private bathrooms and a spiral staircase that leads to the lookout with sweeping views of the community. Explore all that WaterSound can offer at Yachtpound Lane. There is parking for 2 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes—cruise the Timpoochee Trail and visit the rest of Scenic 30A! Guests have access to all WaterSound boardwalks for beach access. Book this captivating coastal home today.
